title: Steering beyond Language: Improving Multilingual Training-Free Text Embeddings via Paired-Residual Subspace Removal
abstract: arXiv:2610.23807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While deriving text embeddings directly from frozen LLMs has emerged as a promising direction, existing methods focus almost exclusively on English, leaving multilingual settings largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multilingual training-free text embeddings in LLMs. Our analysis reveals a language-conditioned embedding geometry in which semantically equivalent sentences remain misaligned across languages. We hypothesize that language-specific variation can be disentangled from semantic content to improve embedding quality. To this end, we propose Paired-Residual Subspace Removal (PRSR), a training-free inference-time intervention that steers LLM representations toward a more language-invariant semantic space. translated_title: 超越语言的引导：通过配对残差子空间移除改进多语言免训练文本嵌入
translated_abstract: 虽然直接从冻结的大语言模型（LLM）中提取文本嵌入已成为一个有前景的方向，但现有方法几乎完全聚焦于英语，多语言场景在很大程度上尚未被探索。在这项工作中，我们首次对大语言模型中的多语言免训练文本嵌入进行了系统性研究。我们的分析揭示了一种语言条件化的嵌入几何结构，即语义等价的句子在不同语言之间仍然存在错位。我们假设语言特有的变化可以与语义内容解耦，从而提升嵌入质量。为此，我们提出了配对残差子空间移除（PRSR）方法，这是一种免训练的推理时干预技术，可将大语言模型的表示引导向更具语言不变性的语义空间。PRSR首先从多语言平行句子中构建配对残差以捕捉语言特有的偏差，然后从这些残差中估计逐层的低秩子空间并对其进行移除（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了大语言模型的多语言免训练文本嵌入，发现跨语言语义等价句子存在嵌入错位问题，并提出PRSR方法，通过从多语言平行句构建配对残差、估计并移除语言特异性的低秩子空间，将模型表示引导至更语言不变的语义空间。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of multilingual training-free text embeddings in LLMs and proposes PRSR, a training-free inference-time intervention that estimates and removes language-specific low-rank subspaces from paired residuals of parallel sentences, steering LLM representations toward a more language-invariant semantic space.
